completion.interpretation: Illustrative depth envelope below the observed height field, tapered to its exact outline. Depth is assumed, not measured. Every added face is missing-data grid.

reduction.qualification: Source fit is checked separately against the full measured DEM, excluding every estimated face.

sourceFit.sampling: Every used vertex and triangle centroid in both directions; not a continuous Hausdorff bound.

coverage.interpretation: Observed Cartesian surface only. Missing samples and the unobserved side remain open.

imageReduction.sampling: Every used vertex and triangle centroid in both directions; not a continuous Hausdorff bound.

simplification.optimizerErrorUnits: Combined planar and normalized height metric; physical metre deviations measured separately.
